wdl.settings.title: Archive World Downloader Settings
wdl.settings.defaults.tooltip: Every setting is already at its default.
wdl.settings.option.show_hud.tooltip:
Draw the live download status on screen while a download runs.
Disabling hides it; chat messages and toasts have their own toggles.
wdl.settings.option.hud_anchor.tooltip: Which screen corner or edge the HUD anchors to.
wdl.settings.option.hud_offset_x.tooltip: Pixel nudge left or right from the anchor.
wdl.settings.option.hud_offset_y.tooltip: Pixel nudge up or down from the anchor.
wdl.settings.option.hud_detailed.tooltip: Show the detailed multi-line HUD by default. When off, the peek key reveals it live.
wdl.settings.option.hud_peek_mode.toolti: How the peek key reveals the detailed HUD: hold it, or toggle it per press.
wdl.settings.option.hud_background.toolt:
Draw a panel behind the HUD.
Disabling draws the text with a drop shadow instead.
wdl.settings.option.hud_panel_opacity.to: How opaque the HUD panel is when shown.
wdl.settings.option.hud_done_linger_seco: How long the finished HUD lingers after a save before it fades.
wdl.settings.option.show_toasts.tooltip: Show a toast in the corner when a download finishes or fails, even with chat hidden.
wdl.settings.option.show_chat_messages.t: Show the mod's chat notices, like the update-available line.
wdl.settings.option.world_type.tooltip:
What fills the space between downloaded chunks.
VOID leaves it empty; DEFAULT and FLAT generate their own terrain, which won't match the server's.
wdl.settings.option.world_seed.tooltip: Seed for DEFAULT and FLAT terrain; any whole number works. Ignored by VOID.
wdl.settings.option.generate_features.to: Generate structures (villages, strongholds, and the rest) in DEFAULT and FLAT terrain.
wdl.settings.option.override_gamerules.t:
Write a curated safe set of game rules into the download.
Disabling writes none, so the world's own defaults stand.
wdl.settings.option.override_world_defau:
Apply the download's game mode and cheats settings.
Disabling opens it in the game mode you're in with cheats off.
wdl.settings.option.open_in_creative.too:
Open the downloaded world in Creative.
Disabling opens in the game mode you were in.
Applies only under Override World Defaults.
wdl.settings.option.allow_commands.toolt:
Enable cheats in the download so /gamemode and /tp work.
Applies only under Override World Defaults.
wdl.settings.option.auto_download.toolti: Automatically start a download when you join a multiplayer server.
wdl.settings.option.capture_entities.too: Include mobs, Item Frames, Paintings, and the Maps they carry.
wdl.settings.option.capture_containers.t: Include the contents of Chests, Barrels, and other containers you open.
wdl.settings.option.recapture_chunks.too:
How up to date the download stays as you explore.

Off: each area is downloaded once and kept as you first saw it.
Nearby: the area around you stays current; areas you've left keep their first download.

Everywhere: revisited areas are refreshed too, but a container keeps its old contents until you reopen it.
wdl.settings.option.lock_downloaded_maps:
Lock downloaded Maps so they keep their picture.
Disabling lets them repaint over the surrounding world; with the default VOID they repaint blank.
wdl.settings.option.remap_map_ids.toolti:
Re-key filled Maps to stable IDs so a server that renumbers map IDs can't mislink them when you resume.
Disabling keeps the original server map IDs in the download.
wdl.settings.option.capture_advancements: Include your advancements, tied to your account.
wdl.settings.option.capture_statistics.t: Include your statistics, tied to your account.
wdl.settings.option.skip_void_chunks.too: Skip a completely empty downloaded chunk to save space. A chunk holding anything at all is kept.
wdl.settings.option.save_player_inventor: Include your inventory so whoever opens the download inherits your stuff.
wdl.settings.option.save_player_ender_ch: Include your Ender Chest, saved only while you have it open during the download.
wdl.settings.option.save_item_coordinate:
Keep coordinates stored on items (Lodestone targets, Bee positions in a Beehive).
Disabling blanks them so they don't reveal world locations.
wdl.settings.option.zip_on_resume.toolti:
Before a resume or restore changes an existing folder, zip it first as a safety backup:
-pre-resume.zip before a resume, -singleplayer.zip before a restore.
wdl.settings.option.confirm_resume.toolt:
Ask before continuing into an existing folder.
Disabling skips the confirmation.
wdl.settings.option.block_tainted_resume:
Block resuming a world that was opened in singleplayer (it may hold generated, non-server chunks).
Disabling warns and asks instead of blocking.
wdl.settings.option.zip_on_finish.toolti:
When a download finishes, also write a shareable .zip beside the folder.
That zip is also the clean backup Restore recovers from.
wdl.settings.option.append_date_suffix.t: Add a -YYYY-MM-DD date to a new download's name, so downloads made on different days sit side by side.
wdl.settings.option.force_mob_persistenc: Keep every downloaded mob from despawning, including ordinary mobs that would naturally despawn.
wdl.settings.option.recapture_seconds.to:
How often the download refreshes the loaded chunks around you.
A longer interval saves work but is slower to catch a change further out.
The 3×3 chunks around you refresh every second regardless.
wdl.settings.option.encode_budget_millis:
How much time each tick the download spends saving.
Higher keeps the save caught up when you move fast; lower is easier on frame rate.
wdl.settings.option.dump_received_frames: Advanced diagnostic: dump every received Item Frame's position to a file for a download-loss audit. Leave off for normal use.
wdl.settings.confirm.capture.title: Disable %s?
wdl.settings.confirm.capture_entities.me:
The download won't include mobs, Item Frames, Paintings, or the Maps they carry,
so the finished world will be missing them.
Chests, Barrels, and other containers will download empty,
so the finished world will be missing their contents.
wdl.settings.confirm.recapture.title: Switch to %s?
wdl.settings.confirm.recapture.to_nearby:
Areas you revisit won't be re-downloaded, so your first download of them is kept;
the area around you stays current as it changes.
wdl.settings.confirm.recapture.to_off.me:
Each area is downloaded once and kept as you first saw it;
later changes, including ones right around you, won't be downloaded.
wdl.settings.defaults.title: Reset all settings?
wdl.settings.defaults.message: Every setting on every tab returns to its default.
wdl.settings.discard.title: Discard changes?
wdl.settings.discard.message: Your unsaved changes will be lost.
